metadata.evidence: We build an instance of streaming video model, namely the streaming video Transformer (S-ViT).
metadata.reason: Names the concrete model implementation provided by the artifact.

metadata.value: S-ViT first produces frame-level features with a memory-enabled temporally-aware spatial encoder to serve the frame-based video tasks. Then the frame features are input into a task-related temporal decoder to obtain spatiotemporal features for sequence-based tasks.
